sn35.10:1.3: Seeing this, a learned noble disciple is not concerned with past sights;
sn35.10:1.5: and they practice for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding present sights.
sn35.10:1.12: Seeing this, a learned noble disciple is not concerned with past ideas;
sn35.10:1.14: and they practice for disillusionment, dispassion, and cessation regarding present ideas.”
